import importlib.util
import json
from pathlib import Path

_HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent


def _load_module(module_name):
    file = _HERE / (module_name + ".py")
    if not file.is_file():
        raise ValueError("missing module file: %s" % file)
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("component_" + module_name + "_" + str(abs(hash(_HERE))), file)
    if spec is None or spec.loader is None:
        raise ValueError("cannot load module: %s" % file)
    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    spec.loader.exec_module(module)
    return module


def _require_str(value, what):
    if not isinstance(value, str) or not value.strip():
        raise ValueError("%s must be a non-empty string" % what)
    return value


def _dump_json(path, obj):
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    path.write_text(
        json.dumps(obj, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, indent=2, allow_nan=False) + "\n",
        encoding="utf-8",
    )


def build_component(root, contract_path):
    root = Path(root)
    contract_path = Path(contract_path)
    model = _load_module("model")
    transform = _load_module("transform")
    contract = model.load_payload(contract_path)
    if not isinstance(contract, dict):
        raise ValueError("contract must be an object")
    _require_str(contract.get("name"), "contract name")
    inputs = contract.get("inputs")
    if not isinstance(inputs, list):
        raise ValueError("contract inputs must be an array")
    for item in inputs:
        _require_str(item, "contract input path")
    _require_str(contract.get("output"), "contract output path")
    payloads = [model.load_payload(root / p) for p in inputs]
    result = transform.transform(payloads, contract)
    if not isinstance(result, dict) or set(result) != {"name", "result"}:
        raise ValueError("transform returned an invalid envelope")
    if result["name"] != contract["name"]:
        raise ValueError("transform returned a mismatched component name")
    _dump_json(root / contract["output"], result)
    return result


if __name__ == "__main__":
    root = _HERE.parents[1]
    build_component(root, _HERE / "contract.json")

import sys, json, copy
sys.path.insert(0,'/app/domains/fit'); sys.path.insert(0,'/app/views/hard'); sys.path.insert(0,'/app/views/soft'); sys.path.insert(0,'/app/views/comparison')
# module name collision: model imported from first path wins. Use importlib per dir instead.
import importlib.util
def load(dir,name):
    spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(name+'_x','/app/%s/%s.py'%(dir,name))
    m=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(m); return m
fitm=load('domains/fit','model'); fitt=load('domains/fit','transform')
hardt=load('views/hard','transform'); softt=load('views/soft','transform'); compt=load('views/comparison','transform')

def case(payload, contract=None):
    c=contract or {"name":"fit","inputs":["inputs/case.json"]}
    return fitt.transform([payload],c)

# 1. load_payload rejects NaN/Infinity/1e999/bad top-level
import tempfile, pathlib
for txt in ['{"a":NaN}','{"a":Infinity}','{"a":1e999}','[1,2]','"x"','not json','{"a":.5}']:
    p=pathlib.Path(tempfile.mktemp()); p.write_text(txt)
    try: fitm.load_payload(p); print('FAIL accepted',txt)
    except ValueError: pass
p.write_text('{"a":1,"b":[2.5]}'); assert fitm.load_payload(p)=={"a":1,"b":[2.5]}
print('load_payload ok')

base=json.load(open('/app/inputs/case.json'))
# 2. wrapper {name,result} unwrap
r=case({"name":"zz","result":copy.deepcopy(base)})
assert r["result"]["sample_count"]==4
# 3. no mutation
b=copy.deepcopy(base); case(b); assert b==base
# 4. duplicate class / bad types
def expect_err(mut):
    d=copy.deepcopy(base)
    mut(d)
    try: case(d); print('FAIL accepted mutation'); return False
    except ValueError: return True
assert expect_err(lambda d: d.update(classes=["red","red"]))
assert expect_err(lambda d: d.update(classes=["red",""]))
assert expect_err(lambda d: d.update(sample_weight=[1,-1,0,1]))
assert expect_err(lambda d: d.update(sample_weight=[1,True,0,1]))
assert expect_err(lambda d: d["members"][0].update(active=1))
assert expect_err(lambda d: d["members"][1].update(id="m47-0"))  # duplicate id incl inactive
assert expect_err(lambda d: d["members"][0].update(predictions=["blue","red"]))  # len mismatch
assert expect_err(lambda d: d["members"][0].update(predictions=["green","red","red","blue"]))
assert expect_err(lambda d: d["members"][0].update(classes=["red","green"]))
assert expect_err(lambda d: d["members"][0].update(probabilities=[[0.5,0.4],[0.7,0.3],[0.4,0.6],[0.8,0.2]]))
assert expect_err(lambda d: d["members"][0].update(probabilities=[[0.5,0.5,0.0],[0.7,0.3],[0.4,0.6],[0.8,0.2]]))
assert expect_err(lambda d: d["members"][0].update(weight=-1))
assert expect_err(lambda d: d["members"][0].update(weight=True))
assert expect_err(lambda d: d["members"][0].pop("id"))
assert expect_err(lambda d: d.update(members=[d["members"][1]]))  # only inactive -> no active member
# inactive member with garbage other fields is fine
d=copy.deepcopy(base); d["members"][1].update(weight="garbage",predictions=None)
r=case(d); assert [m["id"] for m in r["result"]["members"]]==["m47-0","m47-2","m47-3"]
# zero total weight
assert expect_err(lambda d: [m.update(weight=0) for m in d["members"] if m["active"]])
# payload count mismatch
try: fitt.transform([base,base],{"name":"fit","inputs":["a","b","c"]}); print('FAIL count')
except ValueError: pass
# non-finite in extra field
d=copy.deepcopy(base); d["extra"]=float("nan")
try: case(d); print('FAIL nan extra')
except ValueError: pass
print('fit transform ok')

fitres=case(base)["result"]
# 5. hard probes
hc={"name":"hard","inputs":["outputs/fit.json"]}
r=hardt.transform([{"name":"fit","result":copy.deepcopy(fitres)}],hc)["result"]
assert r["predictions"]==["blue","red","red","blue"] and r["scores"]==[[0,8],[8,0],[8,0],[0,8]]
# tie -> first class in global order
d=copy.deepcopy(fitres); d["members"]=[{"weight":1,"predictions":["blue","red"]},{"weight":1,"predictions":["red","blue"]}]
d["sample_count"]=2
r=hardt.transform([{"name":"fit","result":d}],hc)["result"]
assert r["predictions"]==["red","red"] and r["scores"]==[[1,1],[1,1]], r
# misaligned lengths
d=copy.deepcopy(fitres); d["sample_count"]=3
try: hardt.transform([{"name":"fit","result":d}],hc); print('FAIL align')
except ValueError: pass
print('hard ok')

# 6. soft probes: column mapping with permuted classes
sc={"name":"soft","inputs":["outputs/fit.json"]}
r=softt.transform([{"name":"fit","result":copy.deepcopy(fitres)}],sc)["result"]
assert r["predictions"]==["blue","red","blue","red"]
assert r["probabilities"]==[[0.2,0.8],[0.7,0.3],[0.4,0.6],[0.8,0.2]]
# tie in soft -> global class order
d=copy.deepcopy(fitres)
d["members"]=[
 {"weight":1,"classes":["red","blue"],"probabilities":[[0.5,0.5]]},
 {"weight":3,"classes":["blue","red"],"probabilities":[[0.5,0.5]]},
]
d["sample_count"]=1
r=softt.transform([{"name":"fit","result":d}],sc)["result"]
assert r["predictions"]==["red"] and r["probabilities"]==[[0.5,0.5]]
# unknown member class
d=copy.deepcopy(fitres); d["members"][0]["classes"]=["red","green"]
try: softt.transform([{"name":"fit","result":d}],sc); print('FAIL soft class')
except ValueError: pass
print('soft ok')

# 7. comparison probes
cc={"name":"comparison","inputs":["outputs/hard.json","outputs/soft.json"]}
h={"name":"hard","result":{"predictions":["a","b"]}}
s={"name":"soft","result":{"predictions":["a","c"]}}
r=compt.transform([h,s],cc)["result"]
assert r=={"hard":["a","b"],"soft":["a","c"],"disagreements":[1]}
try: compt.transform([h,{"name":"soft","result":{"predictions":["a"]}}],cc); print('FAIL mismatch')
except ValueError: pass
print('comparison ok')
print('ALL PROBES PASSED')
